name: [FLUX.2-klein-9B] Airbrush it! LoRa [STYLE]
description: Highly recommend using it on CivitAI's generator (1 - 1.4 strenght) Base prompt: Turn this into arbzh style Dataset: 100 images okay so i kinda left this account abandoned for like 3 months because of work and life stuff, and honestly i still can’t guarantee i’m fully back because i don’t have that much time right now. but anyway, i wanted to share this LoRa i made because i really like this nostalgic airbrush style. it can basically take almost any image you like and push it into that soft glossy retro airbrush look, with the creamy highlights, smooth gradients, and that kind of old poster / early digital illustration feeling. Some of the images in the preview were made locally and a few are examples i got from the Civit generator so results may vary in terms of quality.
